PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Luxoft, Bengaluru Principal Consultant (Clients – DWS/SCB), 24th Nov. 2023 – 12th Dec. 2025 o Role involved development of in-house tool for Data management for one of the biggest Investment Banks. o Formulated data mapping specifications for the transformation and migration of Data Flow into Delta Surveillance platform
for Market Abuse regulation.
o Collaborated with upstream data source teams to obtain Critical Data Elements (CDEs) for mapping into the MAR platforms. o Creating and managing JIRA tickets for creating User Stories, Tasks, etc. to record the progress of the business solution.
Shell India Markets Pvt. Ltd., Bengaluru
Sr Specialist – Credit Data and Analytics, 1st Aug. 2023 –22th Nov. 2023 o Supporting the development and operations of global credit risk reporting activities within T&S, including working with IT

projects and other ad-hoc requests.
o Preparation of the BRD and Requirement Specification in line with the Business Stakeholders.
• Synechron Technologies Pvt. Ltd., Bengaluru
Lead Business Analyst (Client - HSBC), 30th Nov. 2020 – 14th Jul. 2023 o Regularly interactions with business and technical stakeholders locally and globally, including data vendors, for requirement
discussions and for developing functional solutions for CSDR Penalties regulation.
o Working on BRD, proposing business solutions to given business problems with onshore Business Analysts. o Raising JIRA tickets for creating EPICs, User Stories, Tasks, etc. to record the progress of the business solution. o Perform Data Analysis & Validations, assist testing teams/QA in creating and validating test cases. o Provide UAT support to business users.

JP Morgan Chase India Ltd., Bengaluru Business Analyst – Team Lead (Asset Management), 7th Oct 2019 – 26th Nov. 2020 o Played a key role to develop the Single Counterparty System which will replace the existing legacy systems which are segregated across regions and products. Also, to integrate with the Pre-Trade and Post-Trade Compliance systems. o Working with PM, Trading, Legal and Sales team to analyse and interpret Investment Guidelines as part of Requirements
Gathering process and with production support teams in handling level 3 queries that require functional expertise. o Gathering of requirements for Limits and Margins for Counterparties across different regions as per regulatory requirements and work closely with the team members to implement the requirements on Compliance Systems.
o Partner with various operations team to improve data availability and overall quality of underlying data.
Moody’s Analytics Knowledge Services Pvt. Ltd. (Currently, Acuity Knowledge Partners), Bengaluru
Associate (Client – Wellington Asset Management), 27th Nov. 2017 – 4th Oct 2019 o The Role was to improve and enhance the existing Post-Trade Compliance Process. To identify processes and tasks where
manual calculations were performed and to replace them with automated rules. o Analyse the data related to post-trade breaches which occur on a day-to-day basis. o Prepare the BRD/FRD documents and conduct requirements walk through with development team. o Work with Development team to develop and test Rule Structure for automated compliance testing on test data for
applicable portfolios.
o Identifying the training needs of the team members and creating a Training Plan for new hires.
